 Niqab Shafiq to Anvay Dravid, out Caught by Farhan Yousaf!! This is high, chance in the deep and taken at deep cover. The Pakistani fans are absolutely thrilled and the bowler breaks into his celebration as well. Just as one thought this stand was determined to get a fighting partnership on board, Anvay has given it away. Flighted delivery outside off stump, Anvay couldn't resist himself from playing the inside-out lofted drive that he seems to be so fond of. But the ball hits him on the outer half of the bat and it's a well judged catch at deep cover, running in from the fence.
